settings/language.title: Language
settings/language.body: Select the interface language. System follows the console setting. Restart Akira to apply a change.

settings/connectionShowStages.title: Connection progress
settings/connectionShowStages.body: Show detailed connection stages instead of only the standard loading view while a session starts.

settings/theme.title: Theme
settings/theme.body: Choose the interface color theme. Akira exits after a change; relaunch it to apply the new theme.

settings/version.title: App version
settings/version.body: Current build. Tap seven times to unlock the Power User menu.

settings/enableThreadAffinity.title: Thread affinity
settings/enableThreadAffinity.body: Pin streaming threads to specific CPU cores. Restart Akira to apply a change.

settings/holepunchRetry.title: Holepunch retry
settings/holepunchRetry.body: Try NAT traversal up to four times instead of stopping after the first failed attempt.

settings/requestIdrOnFecFailure.title: Request IDR on FEC failure
settings/requestIdrOnFecFailure.body: Request a fresh keyframe when forward error correction cannot reconstruct a video frame. Recovery may briefly pause video.

settings/packetLossMax.title: Reported packet-loss cap
settings/packetLossMax.body: Cap the packet-loss percentage reported to the console. Lower values may prevent aggressive bitrate reductions, but can cause freezes or unrecoverable frames on poor networks.
